_about: Episode 1 shot list. Each shot = a keyframe still (composed from approved plates and character sheets, or an approved image used directly) + a motion prompt for image-to-video. Paths are relative to the project root. model: 'video' = MODEL_VIDEO, 'hero' = MODEL_VIDEO_HERO. Reaction loops are generated from the 'react' block.
camera: Hand-held camera with gentle operator sway and micro-shake, as if filmed by someone standing in the room.
keep: Keep every face, hair, costume and the set exactly as in the reference image. Photoreal, film grain, no text, no morphing, no extra people.

keyframe.prompt: Medium shot from slightly below the throne: Aurie, the woman from the identity photographs, sits upright on the black glass throne, her face large and clearly lit in the upper third of the frame, utterly still and regal, her long black hair lifting in its own slow wind. At the frame edges: the pale-suited man kneeling with head bowed (back of his head only), Lucienne at her shoulder with lantern and ledger. Starfield walls behind, one candle on the throne arm lighting her face warmly.

shots.motion: Aurie listens without moving; only her hair drifts upward and a thin stream of sand rises from the base of the throne. Lucienne turns a page of her ledger. The kneeling man does not lift his head. Very slow push-in toward Aurie's face.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from the throne: a pale, long-fingered woman's hand in a black sleeve raised in the foreground, palm out. Ahead on the black glass floor a hunched shadowy nightmare creature, all teeth and smoke, is mid-lunge toward the throne. Starfield walls, cool silver light.

shots.motion: The raised hand closes slowly into a fist; the nightmare creature freezes mid-lunge and dissolves from the edges inward into drifting grey sand that pours across the black glass floor. Static first-person framing.

keyframe.prompt: Medium shot, waist up, slightly low angle: Aurie stands before the throne mid-sentence, her face large in frame, as chalk-white lines of a magic circle flare up through the black glass floor around her, lighting her face from below like burning magnesium. Expression: sudden alarm breaking through regal calm. Starfield behind her.

shots.motion: The chalk lines blaze brighter and the circle tightens; Aurie looks down at her feet, then is pulled straight downward through the glass floor in one violent motion, her hair streaming upward. The lines flare white and the frame burns out to black.

keyframe.prompt: Low close shot beside the huge glass sphere in the 1916 candle-lit cellar: inside it, close to the camera, Aurie lies curled on the curved glass in her long black gown, dazed, her face turned toward the camera and clearly visible through the glass, one palm flat against it, her black hair spread around her. Out of focus beyond the sphere: gloved hands lifting away a dark ornate helm, a small leather pouch and a red ruby on a chain, and Roderick Burgess in his burgundy robe watching, triumphant.

shots.motion: Aurie stirs and slowly lifts her head, her palm pressing against the glass. The gloved hands carry the helm, pouch and ruby out of frame. Burgess steps closer to the sphere, triumphant. Candle flames shiver. Slow push-in toward the sphere.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from inside the glass sphere, as in the plate: through the curved scratched glass, Roderick Burgess from the character sheet crouches close outside, his face slightly warped by the glass, lit from below by candlelight, the burgundy robe pooled on the flagstones.

shots.motion: Burgess leans closer, his face swelling in the curve of the glass, lips moving as he speaks; he taps the glass twice with his signet ring and his breath briefly fogs it. Static first-person framing with slight breathing sway.

keyframe.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot past Burgess's blurred shoulder and burgundy robe at the left edge: through the curved glass, Aurie sits utterly still inside the sphere, her face large, sharp and clearly visible, staring back at him in perfect silence. Candlelight on the glass.

shots.motion: A long silent stare. Burgess waits, then his jaw tightens; he stands slowly, straightens his robe and turns away. Aurie does not move or blink. Slow lateral drift.

keyframe.prompt: Medium close shot: inside the glass sphere Aurie has risen to her knees, close to the glass, her face large and sharp in frame, set in cold fury, her breath fogging the glass in front of her. At the right edge of the frame, Burgess recoils a step back, one arm half raised, partly cut off by the frame.

shots.motion: Burgess stumbles back another step, catching himself on the lectern; the candles nearest the sphere gutter and lean away from it. Aurie remains kneeling, staring. Quick small hand-held reaction.

keyframe.prompt: The 1916 cellar: Roderick Burgess beside the glass sphere, head thrown back in contemptuous laughter, one hand on his chest, candlelight on his teeth.

shots.motion: Burgess laughs, then stops abruptly and leans close to the glass, the smile gone, wagging one finger slowly. Slow push-in on his face.

keyframe.prompt: A British soldier of 1916 lies on his back in a muddy trench at night, rain falling, eyes wide open and unblinking, staring at the sky as flares burst overhead. Exhausted, filthy, alive. Photoreal war photography.

shots.motion: Flares drift down and light his face white then red; shells thud in the distance; men around him sleep; his eyes stay open and never close. Slow downward crane toward his face.

keyframe.prompt: A girl of about ten, Edwardian, asleep in a white iron bed in a sunlit English bedroom of 1916, dark hair spread on the pillow, a calendar on the wall beside her. Peaceful, but too still.

shots.motion: Time-lapse: sunlight sweeps across the room again and again; calendar pages peel away and fall; the girl in the bed ages slowly into a grey-haired woman, still asleep, never waking. Static camera.

The palace towers dissolve from the top down into streams of grey sand that pour sideways on a soundless wind and vanish; a whole stairway crumbles away into the mist. The intact reflection below does not change. Slow aerial drift.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from inside the glass sphere in the dusty 1970s cellar lit by a bare bulb: outside the curved glass, Alex Burgess from the character sheet (here about sixty, hair greying, the same black rectangular spectacles, standing, no wheelchair) leans close to the glass, frightened and tender. Behind him in the doorway stands Paul McGuire from his sheet, watching.

shots.motion: Alex lifts one hand and hesitates before laying his palm flat on the glass, his lips forming a question; Paul shifts his weight in the doorway. The bulb flickers once. Static first-person framing.

keyframe.prompt: A dim 1970s English bedroom at night. Alex Burgess from the character sheet (about sixty, his own face, grey at the temples, his black rectangular glasses on the bedside table) sits bolt upright in bed, just woken, tears on his face, one hand over his mouth.

shots.motion: Alex's shoulders shake as he cries silently; he reaches for his spectacles, puts them on, and looks toward the door as if he might go down to the cellar. Slow push-in.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from inside the glass sphere in the 1970s cellar: Alex Burgess (about sixty, his own face, grey at the temples, black rectangular glasses) stands outside the glass, waiting, hands clasped, hope fading from his face.

shots.motion: Nothing comes from the sphere. Alex's face falls; he lowers his eyes, turns and walks slowly to the door, looking back once before he goes. Static first-person framing.

keyframe.prompt: A dream image: Alex Burgess (about sixty, his own face, grey at the temples, black rectangular glasses) stands in the grey-blue dawn cellar staring in horror at his own much older self, white-haired and slumped in a wheelchair under a tartan blanket, beside an empty cracked glass sphere.

shots.motion: The old self in the wheelchair slowly raises its head and looks straight at the younger Alex; Alex stumbles backward and screams soundlessly; the dawn light snaps to black.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from inside the glass sphere at night, 1988: the sleeping security guard from the character sheet has slid down and sits with his back and head resting against the outside of the curved glass, mouth open, breath fogging a small oval on the glass.

shots.motion: The guard breathes slowly in deep sleep; the fogged oval on the glass widens with each breath, and inside the fog, faintly, a warm amber room begins to appear. Static first-person framing.

keyframe.prompt: Medium close shot at night in the 1988 cellar: Aurie is stepping out through the fogged curved glass of the sphere as if through water, her face and shoulders emerging toward the camera, large and clearly lit by the warm amber glow of the pub visible inside the fog; the glass bends around her like skin without breaking. At the bottom edge of the frame the sleeping guard's head rests against the glass.

shots.motion: Aurie steps out through the fogged glass as if through water, rising to her full height beside the sleeping guard, her long black hair lifting in a wind that touches nothing else; behind her the chalk circle crumbles into drifting dust. Slow push-in from a low angle.

keyframe.prompt: Recreate the attached scene exactly (the ruined cellar at dawn, the wheelchair, the scream, the shaft of light, the shattered sphere), but the old man's face must be the man in the identity photographs aged to seventy-two.

shots.motion: Alex is wheeled through the doorway, half turning in the wheelchair, his hand flung up to ward something off, mouth open in a scream; the tartan blanket slides from his knees; dust turns in the dawn shaft.

keyframe.prompt: Alex Burgess, white-haired, the black rectangular spectacles taped at one hinge, jolting awake in a hospital bed in a bare grey room at night, gasping, clutching the sheets.

shots.motion: Alex wakes, gasps, looks around; the room behind him subtly changes, the walls a little closer, the light a little colder; he wakes again, and again, each time into a worse version of the same room. Static camera, hand-held sway.

keyframe.prompt: Alex Burgess, white-haired, spectacles on the bedside table, asleep in an armchair by a window at night, twisting in a nightmare under a tartan blanket.

shots.motion: He twists and mutters through the night, then grey morning light fills the window and his face slowly goes slack and peaceful; he sleeps on, the nightmare gone. Static camera.

keyframe.prompt: The 1988 cellar at dawn, seen from behind Aurie, the woman from the character sheet, in her long black gown, as she walks away toward the open cellar door and the grey-blue morning beyond; the cracked empty sphere behind her; her bare footprints in the dust.

shots.motion: Aurie walks slowly out through the door without looking back, the gown swinging, her footprints appearing in the dust behind her; the dawn light grows as she passes into it. Camera stays, slight sway.

keyframe.prompt: Wide photograph at the ruined gates of horn and ivory from the plate: Aurie, the woman from the character sheet, stands before the split horn gate seen from behind and to the side, looking at the ruin. Beyond the threshold, small in the mist, Lucienne from her character sheet waits with her lantern raised.

shots.motion: Aurie walks slowly between the broken gates, sand drifting around her bare feet; Lucienne lowers her lantern and comes forward a step to meet her. Slow follow from behind.

A slow first-person walk down the long reading table toward the wall of doors; the lantern flame on the table leans as fog seeps under the Neverwhere door and sand trickles from under The Alchemist's door; dust turns in the light. Smooth forward dolly with slight sway.

Lucienne turns toward the camera with the lantern raised, relief breaking through her composure, and her lips form the words 'My lady'; the book on the shelf writes another line by itself. Slow push-in.

moods.warm: softened, a hint of kindness in the eyes
moods.wary: guarded, eyes narrowed, weighing every word
moods.amused: a dry, faint smile, eyebrows lifted
moods.afraid: frightened, eyes wide, drawing back slightly

burgess.setting: Medium close-up in the candle-lit 1916 cellar: Roderick Burgess crouched at the curved glass of the sphere, looking straight into the camera as if through the glass.

alex.setting: Medium close-up in the dusty 1970s cellar under a bare bulb: Alex Burgess, about sixty, his own face with grey at the temples, black rectangular glasses, standing close to the curved glass of the sphere, looking straight into the camera as if through the glass.

lucienne.setting: Medium close-up in the endless library: Lucienne holding her lantern low, looking straight into the camera.

react.motion: A seamless loop: the character holds the mood, breathing, blinking, tiny natural shifts of the head and hands, then settles back into exactly the starting pose by the last frame. Static framing apart from the hand-held sway.

aurie.lock: IDENTITY LOCK, highest priority: Aurie's face must be an exact likeness of the woman in the first two photographs (real photos of her). Copy her real face shape and features precisely: a full, round, soft face, wider than it is long, with full cheeks and a soft rounded jaw; straight, thick dark brows set fairly low; almond eyes with subtle single eyelids and slightly downturned outer corners, dark brown irises; a broad nose with a soft rounded tip; a small mouth with a fuller lower lip. Do NOT slim, narrow, lengthen, sharpen, westernise or beautify her face, do not make her younger, do not change her nose or jaw. Her styling (pale skin, black hair, black gown) may follow the character sheet, but her face follows the photographs.

alex-1970s.lock: IDENTITY LOCK, highest priority: Alex's face must be an exact likeness of the man in the first two photographs (real photos of him), as he looks today with only a little more age. Copy precisely: a very broad, round, full face, wider than it is long, heavy full cheeks and a wide soft jaw; short thick black hair swept up and back with grey at the temples and a little grey through the top; straight dark brows; narrow eyes with single eyelids behind rectangular matte-black glasses (untaped); a broad nose with a rounded tip; full lips with a prominent upper lip; real skin texture with old acne scarring on the cheeks; prominent ears. Do NOT slim, narrow or lengthen his face, do not give him white hair, round glasses or tape, do not beautify him.

alex-1988.lock: IDENTITY LOCK, highest priority: old Alex must be clearly the same man as in the first photograph (a real photo of him) aged to seventy-two. Keep his exact bone structure and features: very broad round face and wide jaw, narrow single-lidded eyes, broad rounded nose, full lips with a prominent upper lip, prominent ears, rectangular matte-black glasses (now taped at one hinge). Age only through white-grey swept-back hair, deeper lines, looser skin and age spots. Do NOT slim or narrow his face or change his features.
